parsed.internal_thinking: I have a surplus of 4 wheat and nothing else. My previous move was placing the robber on Alice's 8-Sheep to slow her down. Since I can't build anything (need Wood/Brick/Sheep) and I'm far from a 3:1 port, my best move is to leverage my wheat surplus. Charlie has 2 Wood and 2 Wheat. I'll propose a trade to Charlie to get Wood or Brick so I can start moving toward a port or a new settlement site. Node 11 is blocked by my own settlement at 12, so I need to extend my road to Node 3 (Wheat port) or Node 10. Given Alice's hostility, I need to secure resources before she blocks me.
parsed.note_to_self: Node 11 is invalid due to the distance rule from Node 12. I need to extend the road to Node 3 or 10. I am currently wheat-heavy and need to diversify via trade or ports.
parsed.say_outloud: Charlie, you've got plenty of timber and I've got the bread. How about a trade to help us both get moving?
